title: Seifert powers Super Giants to maiden Hundred title
byline: Manchester Super Giants clinched their first men’s Hundred title with a five-wicket victory over Trent Rockets in a thrilling final at Lord’s.

title: Sri Lanka getting hotter and hotter
byline: Sri Lanka is expected to experience its temperature rising further next year than previous averages, a climatologist said yesterday.

title: Vietnam Airlines launches direct Colombo flights
byline: Vietnam Airlines has launched direct flights between Ho Chi Minh City and Colombo, strengthening air connectivity between Vietnam and Sri Lanka.

title: Did Navy craft hit sunken wreck of Cyprus-flagged vessel off Angulana?
byline: Salvage preparations are underway to recover the Sri Lanka Navy Fast Attack Craft that sank off Angulana, as a special board of experts appointed by the Navy Commander begins a formal investigation into the incident, the Navy said.

title: 12-year-old boy dies after falling from Colombo apartment building
byline: A 12-year-old boy has died after falling from an apartment building in the Colombo 09 area, police said.

title: Ferrari’s first ever electric car sold for record $40m at auction
byline: Ferrari’s first ever all-electric car has fetched $40m (£29.5m) in a charity sale, setting a record for a new car sold at auction.

title: Govt will have to hold referendum or PC polls to survive: SJB
byline: The government will have to hold some kind of election if to survive in a situation where its popularity is on the decline, Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) MP Mujibur Rahman said today.

title: BJP national spokesperson Shehzad Poonawalla quits party
byline: After days of speculation, Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) national spokesperson Shehzad Poonawalla resigned from the party and its activity membership, saying that he was forced to take the decision due to “certain individuals”.

title: Hayden Panettiere, ’Heroes’ and ’Nashville’ actress, dies at 36
byline: American actress Hayden Panettiere, known for her roles in TV shows such as ’’Nashville’’ and ’’Heroes,’’ has died at the age of 36, US media outlets including ABC News reported on Sunday, citing a statement from her father.

title: Homeopathic medical sector raises concerns over regulatory issues
byline: Concerns have been raised within Sri Lanka’s homeopathic medical sector over alleged irregularities in registrations, professional qualifications and the regulation of homeopathic medicines.

title: Two children rescued after jet ski overturns at Gregory Lake
byline: Two (2) children were rescued by the Sri Lanka Navy after the jet ski they were riding overturned at Gregory Lake in Nuwara Eliya yesterday.

title: Sri Lanka to be transformed into a country like Australia, Handunneththi
byline: Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development Sunil Handunneththi has pledged to transform Sri Lanka into a country offering freedom, equality before the law and opportunities similar to those available in Australia.

title: Six die at temple in India’s Bihar after ’stampede-like’ event
byline: At least six people died and several were injured in an incident ​police suspect was triggered by a ‌falling electricity pole that alarmed a crowd of worshippers at a temple in India’s ​eastern state of Bihar, officials said ​on Monday.

title: New Cooperatives Act to strengthen movement and protect public funds
byline: A new Cooperatives Act aimed at strengthening the cooperative movement, closing legal loopholes and protecting the funds deposited by the public is expected to be introduced soon.A special two-day workshop with representatives from all Provincial Councils, aimed at preparing the new legislation, commenced in Colombo.

title: CBSL governor reports debt reduction with reduced accuracy
byline: The Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe was reported to have stated that Sri Lanka’s national debt burden had fallen, from 105% to 95% of the GDP.

title: Injured Leopard released after treatment
byline: A hill country leopard ( Panthera Padus Kotiya) which was injured after being ensnared in two wire traps laid by poachers at Stonecrop estate in Dimbula Pathana Talawakelle was rescued by wildlife officials and released back to the forest yesterday after several days of treatment.

title: Govt. to enact 22 A into law by September-end or October
byline: Amidst the controversy over the extension of retirement age of judges, the government yesterday said the 22nd Constitutional Amendment Bill, which seeks to extend the retirement age of judges will be enacted into law by Parliament by end of September or early October.

title: Hospital warns of dangerous kite-flying accidents
byline: With the prevailing dry weather and school vacation period, kite flying has become a popular activity among children. However, following an increase in accidents linked to the activity, the Acting Director of Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children, Specialist Dr. Pradeep Ratnasekera, has urged parents and the public to pay close attention to safety precautions.

title: 1,178 inmates have escaped from prisons
byline: Some 1,178 prisoners have escaped from prisons during the last five years, a report from the Department of Prisons revealed.

title: CCID obtains 90-day detention order for drug trafficker Shiran Basik
byline: The Central Criminal Investigation Department (CCID) has obtained approval to detain 48-year-old drug trafficker Shiran Basik for 90 days.

title: Colombo port under threat? Galathea is the warning shot
byline: Colombo has the port. India has the cargo. With nearly, Sri Lanka’s record-breaking port performance hides a strategic vulnerability it can no longer ignore. 45% of Colombo’s transshipment business linked to Indian cargo and half of Colombo’s transshipment business is linked to India. This is both Colombo’s greatest opportunity—and its greatest strategic vulnerability.

title: Sri Lanka CERT warns of scam impersonating Central Bank, police officials
byline: Sri Lanka CERT has warned the public about a sophisticated fraud scheme in which scammers impersonate officials of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Police Financial Crimes Investigation Division (FCID) to steal victims’ bank deposits.

title: Does the Public Have Any Say in Sri Lanka's Budget? The Score Is 9 Out of 100
byline: Sri Lanka is making notable progress in publishing fiscal data, yet ordinary citizens remain almost entirely locked out of shaping how public money is spent. According to the Open Budget Survey 2025, the island scored an encouraging 43 out of 100 for transparency, but a dismal 9 out of 100 for public participation.

title: Trump orders Pentagon to cut back military exercises with South Korea
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday instructed the Pentagon to ’’substantially reduce’’ ​joint military exercises with long-term Asian ally South Korea, citing the cost of the drills and Seoul’s refusal to take part in actions against Iran.

title: Grama Niladhari officers call off TU action
byline: Grama Niladhari (GN) officers have decided to call off their ongoing trade union (TU) action following discussions held today (17) with Minister of Public Administration Professor Chandana Abeyratne and the Secretary to the Ministry.

title: Four bank managers arrested for the first time in Sri Lanka
byline: Four managers of four leading private banks have been arrested in connection with a racket where an estimated US$1 billion has been illegally transferred out of Sri Lanka to foreign countries.

title: Inquiry launched into misplaced school textbooks
byline: A departmental inquiry has been launched into the misplacement of a consignment of school textbooks intended for distribution to schools in the Eastern Province, Deputy Minister of Education Dr Madhura Senevirathna said.

title: Sainthamaruthu Acting OIC arrested over Rs. 20,000 bribe
byline: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) has arrested the Acting Officer-in-Charge (OIC) of the Sainthamaruthu Police Station and a police constable over an alleged attempt to solicit and accept a bribe of Rs. 20,000.

title: VIASL urges higher LTV over import surcharge
byline: The Vehicle Importers Association of Sri Lanka (VIASL) has urged the Government to increase the existing Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio for vehicle purchases if it is unable to remove the temporary 50% surcharge imposed on Customs Import Duty on selected motor vehicles.

title: Donald Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it ‘gets in the way’ of ending Iran war
byline: Donald Trump has again threatened to bomb Oman if it “gets in the way” of his effort to end the US-Israel war on Iran.

title: Bollywood stars told to stop appearing in surrogate ads in Indian state’s food safety drive
byline: Three top Bollywood actors including Shah Rukh Khan must stop ‌appearing in surrogate advertisements for a brand mostly associated with a banned betel nut product, India’s Maharashtra state has said as it intensifies a food safety drive.

title: Liquor shops in Kandy to close for 11 days during Esala Perahera
byline: The Excise Department has taken steps to close liquor shops in several areas of Kandy for 11 days, from tomorrow (18) until August 28, coinciding with the Kandy Esala Perahera.

title: Two women appointed as NTC scheduler officers for first time
byline: Two women have been appointed as scheduler officers of the National Transport Commission (NTC) for the first time in the Commission’s history, among 18 new officers recruited for the positions.

title: Suthar, Jadeja put India in command after Dinusha ton
byline: Sri Lanka were bowled out for 284, leaving India with a 178-run first-innings lead in the rain-affected first Test after Sonal Dinusha’s maiden Test century delayed the hosts’ collapse.

title: President proposes unified defence research centre
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has proposed establishing a single national research and development centre by integrating the existing research and development institutions operated by the Sri Lanka Army, Navy and Air Force, noting that such a move would enable the country to achieve its objectives more efficiently and effectively.

title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
byline: US President Donald Trump’s Middle East envoy Jared Kushner is meeting Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, the premier’s spokesperson has told the BBC.

title: Yala strengthens water supply for wildlife due to dry weather
byline: The Wildlife Conservation Department has taken steps to ensure that wild animals in the Yala National Park have access to adequate water during the current dry weather conditions.

title: Instagram and Facebook could change forever if Meta loses child privacy trial
byline: Meta has been hit with successive losses in court over how its platforms have targeted and harmed young users, but a jury trial set to begin on Tuesday may pose the biggest threat yet to its operations.

title: CSE opens week mixed as large-cap strength offsets broad selling pressure
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange started the week on a mixed note on Monday, 17 August 2026, with the All Share Price Index edging lower while the S&P Sri Lanka 20 Index extended its positive momentum, highlighting continued strength among selected large-cap counters.

title: Yala national park to get major development boost to ease tourist congestion
byline: A special development project is to be implemented at the Yala National Park to improve its physical and human resources while reducing congestion and improving facilities for local and foreign tourists.

title: Slave Island Kovil priest wanted over jewelry theft
byline: The Fort Magistrate’s Court has imposed a travel ban on the chief priest of the Slave Island Lord Murugan Kovil over the alleged theft of temple jewelry valued at approximately Rs. 26.7 million.

title: Govt. aims to make vehicle ownership accessible to every citizen: Vijitha Herath
byline: The Government aims to create an environment where every citizen can afford to own and use a vehicle, Minister Vijitha Herath said.

title: Special information system launched for 2026 Kandy Esala Perahera
byline: The Sri Lanka Police has introduced a special information management system to help the public easily access essential information during the 2026 Kandy Esala Perahera.

title: Elephant takes a peaceful stroll through Kandalama hotel lobby
byline: Guests and staff at a Kandalama hotel were given an unexpected surprise when a wild elephant calmly wandered into the hotel lobby before making its way back outside.
